page.lead: Write in the center, pick a voice and tune settings on the right. Use Clone to create your own voice.

random.label: Random
random.text: The hardest part of content ops isn’t ideas — it’s catching them in time. When something hooks you, don’t copy it yet: note why it works, then retell it with your own story.

health.label: Wellness
health.text: Start the morning with warm water, then move gently for ten minutes. Keep it up for a month and you’ll feel the difference.

tips.label: How-to
tips.text: Here’s a simple productivity trick: rank today’s tasks by importance and finish only the top three first.

local.label: Local life
local.text: Looking for a quiet coffee spot this weekend? There’s a small shop behind this old street — great beans and a sunny window seat.

sub.planWithBatch: Planning · {{batch}} · segments appear as they’re generated
sub.confirm: Edit text and delivery notes, then tap Start dubbing

advanced.confirmTip: Keep delivery notes under 100 characters (longer lines are trimmed at synthesis). Body text is checked against a ~3,500 character soft limit per segment. Changing voice affects synthesis only — tap Re-plan to refresh delivery notes.
advanced.manySegments: Many segments may take longer — track progress under Tasks.
advanced.instructionPlaceholder: Delivery: mood, pace, emphasis, pauses (e.g. calm authority, warm empathy)
advanced.changeVoiceDesc: Affects later synthesis only. Use Re-plan segments to refresh delivery notes for a new voice.

workflow.merged: Batches merged into the full plan.

ingest.principle: Normalize long text, clean odd characters and blank lines, enforce per-segment limits.
ingest.headline: Preparing script…

segment_planner.principle: Split for spoken structure (hook, pain points, offer, close) and draft delivery notes per segment.
segment_planner.headline: AI is planning segments and delivery…

plan_review.principle: Validate segments; trim long delivery notes; split oversized body text at sentence boundaries.
plan_review.headline: Validating segment plan…

segment_tts.principle: Synthesize audio per confirmed script and delivery parameters.
segment_tts.headline: Synthesizing segments…

merge_audio.principle: Concatenate segment audio into one WAV in the browser.
merge_audio.headline: Merging final audio…

finalize.principle: Write metadata and per-segment preview index.
finalize.headline: Advanced dub is ready!
